selected_evidence.requirement: Firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080, rejects unrelated inbound (configuration applied)
selected_evidence.summary: ufw configured with default reject incoming/allow outgoing plus explicit allow rules for 22/tcp and 8080/tcp, then enabled; status verbose shows active with those rules.

selected_evidence.requirement: Firewall rules enforced at kernel level
selected_evidence.summary: nft list ruleset shows input chain policy drop with explicit accept for tcp dport 22 and 8080 (IPv4 and IPv6).

selected_evidence.requirement: Live proof that allowed port works and unrelated port is rejected
selected_evidence.summary: Started a temporary listener on 8080; curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200 while nc to an unrelated port 9999 was refused; listener then cleaned up.
systemctl is-enabled ufw returns 'enabled' both before rule application and after enabling the firewall.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 4d70780a-0bff-4d50-8c53-62faa1ccc945 and confirmed ufw active/enabled with correct rules prior to reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 2 && systemctl reboot' command returned 'reboot scheduled' immediately, before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: proof of changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: First poll still showed old boot_id, second poll timed out during reboot, third poll returned new boot_id ea1bf088-870d-48c2-b297-1dffa22893a8, proving an actual restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: post-restart recovery of firewall state
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, uptime -s shows a fresh boot time (08:50:34, immediately after restart); ufw status verbose shows active/enabled with identical reject-incoming default and allow rules for 22/tcp and 8080/tcp; nft ruleset confirms identical policy drop input chain with accept rules for both ports.
